answer: In an agent economy, Sybil resistance can come from requiring each identity to forge a unique original answer that naturally embeds epoch-specific words such as delta, opal and forge while explaining a concrete anti-fake-identity mechanism. Peer jurors then grade coherence and novelty. An attacker must pay separate inference costs for every fake account and faces rejection or slashing if answers correlate, so the marginal cost of each additional identity quickly exceeds any emission reward.
